modules.responsibility: Entry point for the application. Provides the main structure and links to scripts and styles.
Defines the visual styling for the application.
Main application logic, including initialization, event listeners, and routing between screens.
Processes imported data, calculates scores, and manages the dataset.
Handles saving and loading data to/from localStorage.
Handles data import functionality, including FileReader and textarea input.
Implements the highlight detection logic and displays results.
Provides filter and sort controls and logic for the dataset.
Allows users to manually add or edit highlights in the dataset.
Handles exporting the filtered dataset as a downloadable file.

test_strategy.description: Verify that JSON data can be imported via FileReader or textarea and is processed correctly.
test_strategy.expected_result: Imported data is displayed and processed into the application.

test_strategy.description: Ensure that the scoring function calculates scores accurately and sorts items in descending order.
test_strategy.expected_result: Items are displayed in descending order of their scores.

test_strategy.description: Test that filter and sort controls work as expected for all fields.
test_strategy.expected_result: Dataset is filtered and sorted correctly based on user input.

test_strategy.description: Verify that users can manually add or edit highlights and see the updated dataset.
test_strategy.expected_result: New or edited highlights are appended to the dataset and displayed.

test_strategy.description: Test that the filtered dataset can be exported as a downloadable file.
test_strategy.expected_result: Filtered dataset is downloaded as a JSON file.

test_strategy.description: Ensure that working data is saved to localStorage and reloaded on page load.

acceptance_criteria: Generated project must run locally from index.html under python -m http.server.
Provide a real JSON import path using FileReader and/or a textarea; imported data must be processed by the app.
Implement a real scoring function and sort detected items by score descending in executable JavaScript.
Provide visible filter controls and executable filter logic for the requested fields.
Provide a manual marker form/control that appends a new item to the working dataset and rerenders results.
Provide a real export action using Blob, URL.createObjectURL, an anchor download, and the current filtered result set.
Persist working data locally with localStorage and reload it on page load.
Use domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp/time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score.
